eyebrow: Protection plans widen the log sources
code:
GuardDuty protection plans:
  - S3 Protection        (S3 data events)
  - EKS Protection        (EKS audit logs)
  - RDS Protection        (RDS login activity)
  - Malware Protection    (EBS volume data)
  - Lambda Protection     (Lambda network activity)
caption: Each plan extends coverage beyond CloudTrail, VPC Flow Logs, and DNS — turn on what you actually run.
